items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I remember in rooms how she would sound and in Novello's band, it was never recorded either.

ctx.x: Well, Mildred had that thing too. She was never as loose on a record as she was on this '44 record.
I remember in rooms how she would sound and in Novello's band, it was never recorded either. It had a much different thing about it than records showed.
It was like before when I spoke about walking into a room and hearing a band.
